8b741ce2f82bd07f.description: PetroApp runs fuel payments and fleet control for businesses across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Nigeria, and Thailand. We are now building beyond fuel, with vehicle services, a consumer app for car owners, and more tools for the stations we work with. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the direction and results of a product area, not just its backlog. You will decide what is worth building, make the case for it, and get it shipped. Your product area will be agreed based on your strengths and company priorities. Roles and Responsibilities · Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your product area, tied to company OKRs and measurable outcomes · Decide what not to build. Say no with clear reasons and keep the roadmap focused on the few things that move the numbers · Lead discovery with fleet customers, drivers, station partners, and car owners. Validate demand before committing engineering time · Turn strategy into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and stay close to delivery until it ships · Lead cross-functional work with Engineering, Design, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Compliance · Own delivery speed for your area: shorten the time from idea to release without lowering quality · Set success metrics and guardrails up front, measure results after launch, and act on what the data shows · Design for the hard parts of our business: payments and wallet flows, fraud, regulatory requirements, and products that run in several countries · Spot opportunities in partnerships, new services, and competitor moves, and build the business case for them · Mentor other PMs and raise the bar on how the team writes, prioritizes, and ships · 3+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, mobility, logistics, or B2B SaaS · Owned a product or major product area at scale, with results you can quantify · Strong with data: you define the metrics, find the gaps in them, and pull your own numbers. SQL is a plus · Experience with payments, wallets, or other regulated financial products is a strong plus · Experience with both B2B and B2C products, or with two-sided platforms, is a plus · Excellent stakeholder management. You can get senior leaders, operations teams, and engineers behind one plan · Clear, concise writer · Experience in agile teams and a track record of improving how a team delivers · Strong UX judgment and a habit of working closely with design · Comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution in the same day · Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field · Own a product area with real weight: money, vehicles, and stations, at multi-country scale · Help shape where PetroApp goes next as it grows beyond fuel · Work across payments, NFC-based transactions, fraud prevention, and data in one company · A lean, practical team where decisions are made quickly and results are visible · Report directly to the CPO, with a real voice in product strategy

8b5e6b6db8771be8.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking an Applications Reconciliation & Data Integrity Manager to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of enterprise data flows across core business systems, including ERP, POS, payment gateways, banking platforms, and third-party applications. Role Purpose and Scope The Applications Reconciliation & Data Integrity Manager will own the end-to-end governance, design, and operational effectiveness of financial and operational data integrations and reconciliation processes. The position ensures that all financial data movements are fully reconciled, audit-ready, and compliant with internal controls, IFRS requirements, and IT governance standards. This role acts as the enterprise authority for data reconciliation, integration controls, and data integrity assurance across applications, supporting critical business processes such as financial close, reporting, taxation, and operational analytics. Key Responsibilities Own and govern the enterprise-wide integration and reconciliation framework across all financial and operational systems. Ensure end-to-end integrity of data flows between ERP, POS, payment gateways, banking systems, and third-party applications. Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of integration architecture, reconciliation models, and data validation rules. Oversee all financial reconciliation processes including sales-to-GL, bank reconciliation, POS-to-ERP reconciliation, AP/AR, VAT, inventory valuation, and intercompany transactions. Ensure timely detection, investigation, and resolution of data discrepancies, integration failures, and posting errors. Define and enforce data integrity standards, reconciliation policies, and control frameworks aligned with internal audit, ITGC, ISO 27001, and IFRS requirements. Act as the escalation point for critical data integrity and integration issues impacting financial close and business reporting. Ensure readiness and accuracy of month-end and year-end close processes by validating all financial integrations and reconciliations. Drive automation of reconciliation and integration monitoring using SQL, ETL tools, APIs, and data validation scripts. Develop and maintain dashboards and KPI reporting for data integrity, reconciliation accuracy, and system performance. Lead governance of integration tools and platforms (*, Oracle ARCS, middleware, ETL solutions), ensuring optimal usage and control. Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Tax, Internal Audit, and IT teams to ensure alignment on data integrity and reconciliation standards. Support audit processes by providing evidence, documentation, and traceability of reconciliation controls and integration flows. Own Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical data and integration incidents and ensure corrective/preventive actions are implemented. Continuously enhance data reconciliation and integration capabilities through adoption of automation, AI-based anomaly detection, and data observability tools. Maintain documentation of integration architecture, reconciliation rules, control matrices, and data lineage. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. 8b2f57b90cebbbf2.description: You will take machine-learning use cases from idea to production and build the dashboards and reports that decision-makers use every day. 8b933f45329c876f.description: Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Senior Logistics, Security & Interface Manager to oversee and coordinate logistics operations, site security, and interface management across large-scale construction and engineering projects. The successful candidate will have extensive hands-on site experience, preferably within major infrastructure, mixed-use, industrial, or other complex development projects. The role requires strong leadership and coordination capabilities to ensure the efficient movement of resources, materials, equipment, and personnel, while maintaining robust site security arrangements and effective coordination among contractors, consultants, project stakeholders, and relevant authorities. Key Responsibilities 1. Logistics Management Develop, implement, and oversee comprehensive site logistics plans for large-scale construction and engineering projects. Manage site access, traffic management, transportation routes, material deliveries, storage, laydown areas, and heavy equipment movements. Coordinate logistics requirements with construction teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and project management consultants. Ensure efficient utilization of site resources and minimize logistical constraints that may impact construction progress. Identify potential logistical risks and implement mitigation measures to maintain uninterrupted site operations. Monitor logistics performance and ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable regulations, and safety standards. 2. Security Management Develop and implement project-wide security strategies, policies, and procedures to safeguard personnel, assets, equipment, and project facilities. Oversee site security operations, including access control, perimeter security, surveillance, visitor management, and security personnel. Coordinate with security contractors, local authorities, emergency response teams, and other relevant stakeholders. Conduct security risk assessments and implement appropriate preventive and contingency measures. Investigate security incidents and ensure timely reporting, documentation, and corrective actions. Ensure security arrangements are aligned with project requirements and applicable local regulations. 3. Interface Management Lead and coordinate interfaces between construction contractors, engineering consultants, project management teams, utility providers, government entities, and other stakeholders. Identify, monitor, and resolve physical, operational, logistical, and organizational interface issues across project packages. Establish effective interface coordination procedures, communication protocols, and reporting mechanisms. Facilitate interface meetings and ensure timely resolution of issues affecting construction activities and project delivery. Maintain interface registers, action trackers, risk logs, and coordination plans. Proactively identify potential conflicts between contractors, construction activities, and project infrastructure to avoid delays and disruptions. 4. Leadership & Reporting Provide strategic direction and leadership to logistics, security, and interface teams. Monitor departmental performance against project schedules, milestones, and operational objectives. Prepare management reports, performance dashboards, risk assessments, and progress updates. Work closely with the Project Director, Construction Director, and other senior project stakeholders to ensure seamless project execution. Drive continuous improvement in logistics efficiency, security management, and interface coordination. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Logistics, Security Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience , with substantial exposure to large-scale construction, engineering, infrastructure, or mega development projects. Extensive hands-on experience in site-based logistics management, security operations, and construction interface coordination. Proven experience managing complex construction sites involving multiple contractors, work packages, and project stakeholders. Strong understanding of construction logistics, traffic management, site access control, security protocols, and interface management processes. Experience working within a PMC, EPC, main contractor, or major project delivery environment is preferred. Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with senior project management and external stakeholders. Excellent communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Strong reporting, planning, risk management, and organizational capabilities. Preferred Experience Experience working on major GCC construction, infrastructure, or giga-project developments. Exposure to complex, multi-package construction environments with significant logistical and security requirements. Familiarity with local authority requirements, security regulations, and construction site operational standards in the GCC. Professional certifications in logistics, security management, project management, or interface management would be an advantage.

Ensure approved trends and changes are integrated into the overall project Estimate at Completion (EAC) and budget for cost and quantities. Prepare routine performance reports and specialized studies related to the assigned scope for presentation to project, corporate, or customer management teams. Maintain open communication with other organizations to support cost engineering analysis and control activities. Demonstrated experience in cost control activities for large-scale construction projects. Proficiency in preparing cost forecasts, analyzing cost trends, and implementing cost control measures. Strong analytical skills for identifying and solving cost engineering challenges. Work Environment and Company Culture This full-time position is based in Saudi Arabia, with project locations near Taif and Riyadh. Bechtel fosters a diverse and inclusive work environment, valuing a multitude of nationalities, cultures, and experiences. Eaton is pursuing significant growth, with a goal to double sales across EMEA by 2030. Role Overview Eaton is seeking a Specification Sales Engineer - PMCC to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves promoting and selling LV switchgear and Busway systems within the Commercial & Infrastructure segments. The position requires a combination of technical expertise, sales acumen, and relationship management to support panel builders, contractors, consultants, and end-users. Key Responsibilities Promote and sell LV switchgear and Busway systems in commercial and infrastructure segments. Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve regional targets and business growth objectives. Identify and engage with consultants, contractors, end-users, and panel builders to generate leads and foster long-term partnerships. Conduct product presentations and provide training sessions for customers and panel builders. Collaborate with design and engineering teams to develop customized and optimized LV switchgear proposals for project acquisition. Track project pipelines from tender to execution, ensuring timely follow-up for order conversion. Maintain strong customer relationships and provide post-sales technical support to ensure satisfaction. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and pricing strategies to enhance business positioning. Work Environment This position is based in Riyadh and operates on a full-time basis. The successful candidate will work within a team that values equality and inclusivity, contributing to the delivery of energy-efficient solutions.

Act as the Lounge In-Charge, making operational decisions when the Lounge Manager or Duty Manager is absent. Supervise all lounge functions, including reception, F&B, and housekeeping, to ensure seamless operations. 8bbb9227d4844ad6.description: Job posting location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Position Objective: Lead the assessment, design and implementation of Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO) operational excellence programme. Develop a future-state Target Operating Model (TOM), strengthen asset management and maintenance governance, improve reliability and operational performance, and establish organisational readiness for ISO 55001 and ISO 50001 certification. Job Description & Key Responsibilities: Conduct a comprehensive current-state assessment of MRO operations, benchmarking existing practices against ISO 55001, ISO 50001, Society for Maintenance & Reliability Professionals (SMRP) standards and relevant Saudi market best practices. Design the future-state MRO Target Operating Model, including maintenance governance, organisational structures, processes, roles and responsibilities, aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. Establish asset reliability and performance excellence frameworks, incorporating Reliability-Centred Maintenance (RCM), Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and continuous improvement methodologies. Evaluate and optimise preventive and corrective maintenance (PM/CM) strategies, maintenance planning, scheduling, work order management and execution processes. Assess maintenance contracting, outsourcing arrangements, contractor performance and spare parts localisation opportunities. Develop appropriate contractor management processes, service-level agreements (SLAs) and performance monitoring frameworks. Develop ISO 55001 and ISO 50001 readiness roadmaps, including gap assessments, compliance action plans, mock assessments, documentation reviews and support for the Energy Management System (EnMS). Define maintenance and asset performance KPIs, MRO metrics and reporting dashboards to support data-driven decision-making and executive oversight. Facilitate stakeholder engagement, change management and knowledge transfer workshops to build internal capabilities and support sustainable adoption of the future-state operating model. Prepare high-quality assessment reports, strategic recommendations, implementation roadmaps and executive-level presentations for the beneficiary department. Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline. Master’s degree or MBA is preferred. Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in maintenance, reliability engineering, asset management and MRO strategy, including operating model design or consulting. Demonstrated experience in field asset management and Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). Proven capability in executive advisory, maintenance transformation, stakeholder management and organisational change management. Experience in developing maintenance strategies, governance frameworks, performance improvement plans and ISO management system readiness programmes. Advanced proficiency in SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM) and Plant Maintenance (SAP PM). Strong knowledge of MRO metrics, maintenance KPIs and performance dashboards using Power BI or Tableau. Working knowledge of maintenance planning and project scheduling tools; MS Project or Primavera P6 experience is an advantage. Strong understanding of RCM, RCA, preventive and corrective maintenance, contractor management, SLAs and spare parts localisation. Knowledge of ISO 55001 asset management and ISO 50001 energy management requirements. CMRP, ISO 55001 Lead Implementer or an Institute of Asset Management (IAM) Certificate is required. ISO 50001 Lead Implementer and PMP certifications are advantageous.

إعداد الميزانيات التقديرية ومراقبة التكاليف والمصروفات المتعلقة بالمشاريع. توزيع المهام والمسؤوليات على فرق العمل ومتابعة الأداء والإنجاز. التنسيق مع الإدارات الداخلية والعملاء والموردين لضمان سير 8bcc9d92571bf60d.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a Senior Planner/Planner to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is critical for maintaining and monitoring project schedules, ensuring timely and cost-effective project delivery. The role involves coordinating planning activities across various project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders. Project Overview: Ar Rjum Gold Project The Ar Rjum Project is a greenfield gold project located within the Central Arabian Gold Region, approximately 200 km north-east of Taif towards Riyadh, and about 26 km south of Al Mouwayh. This comprehensive project includes three open-pit mining operations with associated waste dumps and ore stockpiles, a processing plant, tailings management facilities, and essential supporting infrastructure such as water and power supply, maintenance facilities, offices, and both temporary and permanent accommodation villages. The role will be based in one of the following cities: Taif, Riyadh, or Jeddah. Key Responsibilities Review and provide EPCM's consent to the Contractor's schedule of works, ensuring alignment with Contract conditions and EPCM Recommended Practices. Validate the compatibility of project resources to ensure timely project completion. Maintain and monitor the Master Schedule, integrating progress from different departments and contractors. Identify potential areas of delay or slippage, highlight critical events, and suggest mitigation measures or corrective actions. Conduct "What if" analyses to assess the time impact of changes, variations, and potential events early, providing alternative courses of action and advice before issuing instructions to contractors. Discuss, coordinate, and resolve planning and scheduling problems with contractors and the Employer. Attend various meetings, including kick-off, technical, and progress reviews, providing valuable input and preparing concise minutes. Prepare trackers and logs to monitor critical issues during the design and construction stages of the project. Assist in preparing delay notices for contractor's culpable delay and/or slow performance letters. Review weekly and monthly progress reports submitted by Contractors. Review and validate Contractor progress measurement methodologies and earned value reporting systems. Compare planned progress with actual performance and identify delays, variances, and potential schedule risks. Conduct variance analysis and provide recommendations for corrective and preventive actions. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling, preferably within large-scale industrial or mining projects. A strong understanding of EPCM contract conditions and recommended practices is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia, supporting the Ar Rjum Project. The role requires active coordination with diverse teams and stakeholders in a dynamic project environment.

Manage the signal integrity strategy across retimers, MCIO, cabled PCIe, risers, backplanes, and channel loss budgets, collaborating with layout and SI engineers. Lead power and thermal architecture for dense, high-TDP accelerator configurations, covering CRPS power delivery, airflow, and liquid-cooling readiness. Define BIOS/UEFI and BMC requirements, working with the ILM software team on bring-up, telemetry, firmware, and fabric integration. Write platform specifications and reference designs for JDM partners, and own design reviews of schematics, layouts, and BOMs. Select and manage ODM and JDM partners for motherboards, chassis, and PCIe switches, driving platforms through EVT, DVT, and PVT into production. Drive Design for Test and Manufacturing (DFx) with the manufacturing team to ensure testability at board, server, and rack levels. Lead failure analysis and root cause for platform issues from power-on through mass production, developing corrective-action reports and debug guides. Build validation and test automation in Python and Bash, integrated with ILM telemetry. Build and lead the hardware platform team, including board design, SI/PCIe, mechanical/thermal, platform firmware, and platform validation and test. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in hardware system architecture. Demonstrated experience in shipping dense multi-GPU platforms. Experience with lane budgets, switch partitioning, and bringing systems through EVT, DVT, and PVT into volume production. Proficiency in platform quality assurance, including validation at board, server, and rack levels. Company Values Think AI operates on four core principles: Ownership: Taking responsibility for outcomes, managing resources frugally, and prioritizing the mission. Agility: Moving with velocity, shipping quickly, iterating, and committing once decisions are made. Impact: Building for the customer, thinking broadly, executing simply, and measuring success by outcomes. Mastery: Deeply addressing complex problems, maintaining excellence as a default, and taking pride in customer satisfaction. Benefits Opportunity to work with one of the first deep tech companies in the region, developing foundational technology in-house. Meaningful ownership and impact at an early stage. Competitive early-stage compensation. Close collaboration within a small, senior team. Engagement with problems combining hardware, systems, and AI at scale.
